A '''planet''' was located in the [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill system]] within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Omens" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' to "eight years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]," for a date of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified starship (Kolatill system)|starship]] was attacked and left adrift near this [[Planet/Legends|planet]] around the same [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]''&mdash;a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] serving in the [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]&mdash;[[Bombing of Domaz|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Domaz]].<ref name="Omens" />

A [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] patrol from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''&mdash;in-[[Star system/Legends|system]] responding to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] from Kolatill&mdash;discovered the derelict five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the bombing. The crew of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] dispatched rescue teams to search the wreck for any survivors still alive in airtight sections or in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Omens" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was mentioned in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] "[[Omens]]", part of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. The existence of the planet was revealed when part of the scenario detailing possible side adventures that the players may undertake mentioned that the crew could discover a derelict ship "out between planets." The players could search the ship for crew members that may still be alive, although whether they discover any is left to the discretion of the gamemaster.<ref name="Omens" />
